title: Stomp
wikitext:
Stomping someone deals 10 damage to the opponent and 5 to yourself. It works by jumping and landing on your opponent from such a distance that [[falldamage]] would be applied. It's  not common but a fun technique to humiliate your enemies. Works in [[KTpro]] and [[KTX]] so you can do it on any [[QuakeWorld]] server

{{terminology}}
